input.summary: Settled 28 of 30 controls: clear-majority combat/menu bindings taken as evidenced from their own profiles (right_stick, right_bumper, left_bumper, left_trigger, B, X, Y), a few adjusted for this game's different job (left_stick, left_joy_down) or picked with low confidence from thin/tied history (dpad_W, dpad_E, dpad_N, dpad_S, start, back). The 13 kb_*/mouse_right_button outputs have no documented Elden Ring function and no habit history, and this profile is otherwise fully controller-based, so they are left untouched/unbound rather than guessed — no proposal written for them. Asked about left_joy_up (puff vs joystick-tilt for forward movement, 47/35 split) and right_trigger (puff vs joystick-tilt for strong attack, tied 27/27) since these are genuinely different ways to play and their history doesn't lean clearly either way.
